content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The C-STATE contract is a licence question: the draft model, the recording verb, the untracked state directory, init's directories, and the operation/lifecycle table fix what a draft's durable state may be. This gate checks only that no clause of C-STATE contradicts one of those prerequisites, naming the clause and the prerequisite it departs from; it states no further requirement of its own.
